introHtml: Crystal shot glasses bring a level of clarity and brilliance that standard glass can't match. The lead-free crystal material offers a smooth, weighty feel that elevates any toast or tasting event. For marketing directors planning upscale client gifts or HR directors celebrating company milestones, custom crystal shot glasses etch beautifully with logos or text using sandcarving or screen printing. The result is a sophisticated giveaway that stands out at trade shows or corporate bars.
